title: International Market Expansion
description: Your SaaS has solid US PMF with $2M ARR. Model the decision to expand into Europe, APAC, or LATAM — including localization costs, go-to-market strategy, and the risk of distracting the core US growth engine.

options.label: Hire a local country manager
options.description: Bring on a full-time country manager with local networks and language skills. High fixed cost ($150-250k/yr fully loaded) but fastest to enterprise deals and local credibility.

options.label: Go via channel partners or resellers
options.description: Partner with established local players who already have customer relationships. Lower upfront cost but slower ramp, margin sharing (20-40%), and risk of misaligned incentives.

options.label: Product-led, remote-first expansion
options.description: Let inbound demand and self-serve growth lead. No local hire — support through existing team with localized pricing and onboarding. Cheapest but slowest enterprise penetration.

current_arr_usd.label: Current US ARR ($)
current_arr_usd.description: Your annual recurring revenue in the home market at the time of expansion.

expansion_budget_usd.label: Year 1 Expansion Budget ($)
expansion_budget_usd.description: Dedicated budget for international expansion including headcount, marketing, and legal.

target_region.label: Target Region
target_region.description: Primary international market to enter first.

compliance_budget_usd.label: Regulatory Compliance Budget ($)
compliance_budget_usd.description: Legal and compliance investment for target region (GDPR, data residency, SOC 2, etc.).

target_intl_arr_yr2_usd.label: Year 2 International ARR Target ($)
target_intl_arr_yr2_usd.description: ARR goal from international customers by end of year 2.

us_growth_slowdown_accepted.label: Accept US Growth Slowdown
us_growth_slowdown_accepted.description: Willing to accept an estimated 15-25% reduction in US growth velocity to fund international expansion.
